orderingChecks.round5Note: round-5 2x consecutive ordering re-run under the campaign bench lock; BOTH passes PASSED (stability spread 0.01345 then 0.02745; broken<naive<baseline<improved; shortcut inverts train->validation). Superseded by the round-6 exec-boundary re-run below; the round-5 retained report hash was sha256:e8432da693aa8fc5e6075a34db5955204ca940387b2cb3cfc4e741270456019c.
orderingChecks.round6Note: round-6 exec-boundary harness (trusted dlopen-after-auth, read-back checksum fold, 4x paired plausibility band, initializer audit, kernel per-sample memory idle/rise gates) changed the measurement completely, so a fresh 2x consecutive ordering was run under the campaign bench lock on a calm host (1-min loadavg 13-17): pass 1 PASSED (spread 0.02486, wall 880.4s, report sha256:bb2db5ed...), pass 2 PASSED immediately after (spread 0.01353, wall 889.1s, report sha256:51c05535...). Both passes: broken<naive<baseline<improved and shortcut wins train / loses validation. ordering-check --report overwrites diagnostics/ordering-report.json in place; the retained + manifest-pinned report is the SECOND pass (firstReportHash is the preserved pre-overwrite hash of the pass-1 report). All calibration fields (aa/qBase/qReference/normalizationScale/controls/perturbation) are re-derived from the retained second pass.

determinism.round5Note: per-sample checksums are now nonce-bound (the go-token is folded into every allocation's canary pattern) and are validated by the trusted parent against the pristine reference's checksum for the same nonce rather than a sealed constant; the nonce=0 validation-pass D-line checksum remains stable and equals the sealed baseline fold (verified: all sealed expectedChecksum values reproduce bytewise at nonce=0).
determinism.round6Note: round-6 replaced the arithmetically-recomputed pattern fold with a read-back fold: every workload folds the 64-bit word LOADED from each live block (hone_block_readback, separate TU, no LTO) after the round's allocations are live, so the checksum's provenance is the allocated memory itself. The folded VALUE is unchanged (little-endian head canary), so all 8 sealed expectedChecksum values still reproduce bytewise through the dlopen harness on both splits.

memoryCalibration.baselineDefinition: per split and workload, maximum observed page_committed.peak and live-page fragmentation over 13 token-locked fresh-process baseline memory passes; evaluator permits at most 2% above that frozen page-committed baseline, backstopped by a 1.5x committed<->kernel-cgroup consistency cross-check and a 2x whole-tree cgroup ceiling / 0.25x floor

measurement.platform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max
measurement.benchmarkSampleSelection: per workload, the candidate and the pristine reference are timed interleaved (7 samples each) and scored as q = sealed operations * (min reference elapsed / min candidate elapsed); host contention can only lengthen a measured region, so the per-binary minimum rejects scheduler-noise outliers and the reference ratio cancels sustained per-eval load with no candidate-controlled influence
measurement.round2Note: round-2 hardening changed bench measurement semantics (per-allocation canaries, live-range overlap rejection folded into every timed round; trusted cgroup whole-tree memory.peak gate at 1.20x sealed baseline). Throughput scale dropped accordingly (ordering baseline ~2.74e7 ops/s). aa/qBase/qReference/normalizationScale predate this change and are superseded; they are re-derived during the already-required frozen-host GCE recalibration (finalGceRecalibrationRequired remains true).
measurement.round4Note: round-4 moved benchmark timing, completion, and result emission out of the candidate-linked executable into the trusted evaluator (child streams work-completion tokens over a report fd while the parent owns fd 1 and brackets each measured region with its own monotonic clock across a per-sample fresh-nonce handshake; whole-tree cgroup memory floor rejects a completion stream produced without allocating) AND replaced the absolute throughput with a load-cancelling yardstick: each workload builds a pristine reference (sealed baseline allocator from TRUSTED_DIR, no candidate overlay) and scores the min-of-N ratio of reference to candidate, so a fully contended eval elevates both legs together and leaves the score unchanged. aa/qBase/qReference/normalizationScale re-derived under this harness from 6 pooled fresh-process baseline runs.
measurement.round5Note: round-5 EXEC-BOUNDARY hardening (candidate allocator code shares the timed process): the per-sample go-token nonce is now folded into every allocation's canary pattern so the reported per-sample checksum can only be produced by running the timed per-allocation fold once the nonce arrives (closing the closed-form seed/rounds precompute path a candidate constructor could echo before main); the trusted parent hands the same nonce to candidate and pristine reference and rejects any sample whose checksum diverges. The candidate-written D-line peak_committed is cross-checked against the kernel cgroup whole-tree peak (rejected if it exceeds 1.5x the kernel-charged peak) and the whole-tree cgroup floor is retained at 0.25x (a scalar floor cannot encode workload shape; the shape signal is the per-workload committed baseline plus fragmentation band).
measurement.round6Note: round-6 moved the process boundary itself: the trusted harness binaries (hone-single/multithread/small/fragmentation) are compiled as root exclusively from sealed TRUSTED_DIR sources and link NO candidate code; the candidate is built as a shared library only and is dlopen(RTLD_NOW|RTLD_LOCAL)ed ONLY after the parent's control-channel auth handshake (A-token -> hone_checksum fold reply), so no candidate instruction can execute at process startup or auth time and library initializers run at a trusted-chosen instant when no sample nonce exists. Added: per-sample paired plausibility floor (cand_ns*4 < ref_ns fails) plus a 4.0x cap on the final min-of-N ratio; an initializer-profile audit of the candidate .so against the pristine reference .so (added initializers rejected, .preinit_array rejected outright); kernel-observable per-sample memory gates on the measurement leaf's memory.current (post-purge idle <= idle_max, timed-window rise >= work_min: single 4M/4M, multithread 6M/4M, small 2M/640K, fragmentation 4M/32M); RLIMIT_NPROC zero-slack task budgets. aa/qBase/qReference/normalizationScale/controls/perturbation re-derived from the round-6 retained ordering pass (finalGceRecalibrationRequired remains true for the frozen-host GCE pass).
